title: rollout-start
description: Starts a staged rollout of one release (docs/spec/07-upgrade-channel.md "Staged rollout"): batch 1 is the one cabinet named here, batch 2 the in-office cabinets, batch 3 about 5 percent of the rest of the fleet, batch 4 everyone else. A batch must reach successRatePercent before the next starts; failures above failureLimitPercent of a batch pause the rollout on their own. A release is one version for one Windows architecture, so the version alone does not name one: the architecture does, and only cabinets built for it are ever targets - the others could not run the package at all.

architecture.description: Which Windows the release being rolled out is for. Cabinets of the other architecture are left out of every batch and counted in the audit as wrongArchitecture, so a rollout can never offer a package a cabinet cannot run.

stepUpToken.description: A one-time step-up token bound to this exact action.
